integrity: A complete analytic proof and a reproducible standard-library numerical/exact-rational checker are included. Finite checks do not certify the universal theorem; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real degree-one trigonometric polynomials and equal antipodal atomic masses only, 0<w<1. The w=1 value is not defined as a three-dimensional L2 projection. Higher-degree and unequal-mass cases unproved.
title: Sharp endpoint norm and perpendicular rigidity for antipodally perturbed trigonometric least squares
